A thread-safe LRU cache with per-entry TTL (time-to-live) expiry.

Features
--------
- O(1) get/set/delete via an ordered hash map (dict + doubly linked list).
- Per-entry TTLs with lazy expiry on access plus a background sweeper
  thread that purges expired items periodically.
- Thread safety via a single re-entrant lock (safe for re-entrant use).
- Bounded memory: capacity enforced by LRU eviction.
- Full type hints and docstrings.
- Statistics: hits, misses, evictions, expirations.

Classes
-------
LRUCache
    The cache itself.
CacheEntry
    Internal record for a single cached value (exposed for testing).

Example
-------
>>> cache = LRUCache(capacity=2, default_ttl=60.0)
>>> cache.set("a", 1)
>>> cache.get("a")

>>> import time
>>> cache.set("b", 2, ttl=0.05)
>>> time.sleep(0.1)
>>> cache.get("b") is None
